title: crataegus ovalifolia
intro: Crataegus ovalifolia, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion, such as bloating and nausea. The health benefits of Chinese hawthorn include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and organic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
